contract.intent: A SPECS GrillArea on the portable grill: expand the seeded goal (grounded on the docs in force + the deferred HOW notes) into ONE amendable spec doc in docs/, on the same ANSWER/RESPONSE/DISCUSS/DECISION loop; and the AMEND path — a SPECS session can target an existing spec doc and produce a revised version, because specs are living, amendable guidance (unlike the immutable goal).
acceptanceCriteria: A SPECS GrillProfile is registered on the portable GrillSession core (like the goal and design profiles), grilling toward ONE named spec doc (default the requirements spec) at requirements/system-design level, deferring code-level implementation

On GO it writes the spec doc to docs/<name>.md and regenerates the manifest, concluding via a git commit plus evidence (docs are git content); the session is interactive like goal! seed and exposes the same exhaustion-driven loop

AMEND: a SPECS session may target an existing in-force spec doc, grounded on the current doc plus the goal and work context, producing a REVISED version committed to docs/ (the doc stays current; the old version lives in git history) — specs are amendable and keep serving future work
The first target consumes the seeded goal and the deferred HOW notes, and grinds them into a concrete, checkable requirements spec
The full suite stays green and ann check/verify stay clean on the live journey; committed with evidence
